summary.text: Shaneka Henson is a Democratic Maryland state senator from District 30 in Anne Arundel County who was appointed in January 2025 and is seeking election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney and former Annapolis city council member, she served in the House of Delegates from 2019 to 2025.

paragraphs.text: Shaneka Henson was born in Anne Arundel County on July 29, 1983.
She holds a B.S. from Coppin State University and a J.D. from the University of Baltimore School of Law, and she was admitted to the Maryland bar in 2010.
Henson worked as an attorney for the YWCA of Annapolis and Anne Arundel County and in the Office of the Maryland Attorney General from 2013 to 2019.
Henson represented Ward 6 on the Annapolis City Council from 2018 to 2019.
She served in the Maryland House of Delegates for District 30A from 2019 to 2025.
Gov. Wes Moore appointed her to the state Senate on January 8, 2025, to replace Sarah Elfreth.
According to the General Assembly website, she serves on the Judicial Proceedings Committee.
